"""Page through a warehouse account and return available stock."""

from __future__ import annotations

from src.feed import Feed
from src.models import Item
from src.stock import is_available

DEFAULT_LIMIT = 2


class InventoryClient:
    def __init__(self, feed: Feed, limit: int = DEFAULT_LIMIT) -> None:
        if limit < 1:
            raise ValueError("limit must be positive")
        self.feed = feed
        self.limit = limit

    def list_available(self, account: str) -> list[Item]:
        items: list[Item] = []
        cursor: str | None = None
        seen: set[str] = set()
        while True:
            page = self.feed.fetch(account, cursor, self.limit)
            items.extend(row for row in page.items if is_available(row))
            # next_cursor alone decides whether more data exists. Page size is
            # not a reliable end marker: some accounts (ops, treasury) return
            # short pages mid-catalog with a live cursor.
            if not page.next_cursor or page.next_cursor in seen:
                break
            seen.add(page.next_cursor)
            cursor = page.next_cursor
        return items
EOF

@pytest.mark.parametrize("account", ["treasury", "ops", "retail"])
def test_short_middle_page_with_cursor_imports_tail(account):
    feed = ScriptedFeed({
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c2", 2): Page((item("D"), item("E")), None),
    })
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available(account)
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
    assert feed.calls == [(account, None, 2), (account, "c1", 2), (account, "c2", 2)]


def test_short_last_page_without_cursor_stops():
    feed = ScriptedFeed({
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), None),
    })
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("treasury")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C"]
    assert len(feed.calls) == 2


def test_repeated_cursor_does_not_loop_forever():
    feed = ScriptedFeed({
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c1"),
    })
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("treasury")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C"]
    assert len(feed.calls) == 2
EOF
